one_line_description: Customer support software with shared inbox and knowledge base
auth_methods_evidence: Help Scout API v2 uses OAuth 2.0; v1 uses Basic Auth with API key. Composio lists OAUTH2, Nango lists BASIC — both are correct for different API versions. https://developer.helpscout.com/docs-api/
self_serve_evidence: To generate, view, or regenerate the API key, click the "person" icon on the top right of your account, next to the search, then click Your Profile. Next, click the Authentication link in the menu on the left and select API Keys tab
buildability_rationale: Self-serve API key authentication with good documentation and medium API breadth, though Composio shows OAuth2 while docs show API key.
agent_notes: The documentation shows API key authentication via Basic Auth, while Composio registry indicates OAuth2 support. Both authentication methods may be available for different parts of the platform.
